title: Run spec parity and quality gates for workspace dedupe
description:
## Goal
Prove the deduplication change meets the repository's quality gates before the PR merges.

## Scope
- `tools/check_spec_parity.py` passes with no step definitions in only one implementation.
- `behave` and `cargo test` pass for the workspace-deduplication scenarios.
- Format, lint, and doc gates pass: `black --check python/`, `ruff check python/`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`.
- Coverage ratchet (`tools/coverage_ratchet.py`) does not widen the gap beyond `config/coverage-baselines.json`.

## Done when
- All gates green on the feature branch and CI is green on the PR into develop.
